about_item: 🐶Comfort & Security Edge: Raised four walls and pillow-like rectangular dog bed provide good support and cushion for the dog's head and neck, the super-soft filling offers joint and muscle pain relief. and allowing your puppy to have a comfortable and restful sleep. Low leading-edge design is easy access for small and old dogs.

🐶Ultra Soft Material: Pet bed is covered in rose swirl short faux fur and cozy suede fabric, which is soft and warm during the winter and effectively retains your pet’s body heat. the bottom and sides stuffed with thickened and eco-friendly pp cotton to create a breathable and comfortable sleeping environment, which keep your dog away from the floor, the surface plush is warm and cozy, In no time, your pet will be snoozing away in the elevated comfort of this dog bed.

🐶Size Details: Small dog bed for Small dogs up to 15lbs, the outer size is 20"x19"x6"; Medium dog bed for Medium dogs up to 30lbs, the outer size is 25"x21"x8"; Large dog bed for Large dogs up to 40lbs, the outer size is 30"x24"x9"; X-Large dog bed for Jumbo dogs up to 60lbs, the outer size is 35"x25"x9"; XXL dog bed for Large dogs up to 80lbs, the outer size is 42"x30"x10"; Please be sure to confirm the size.

🐶Washable Dog Bed: Durable pet bed machine washable as a whole. Gentle cycle and thoroughly dried in dryer directly after washing and do not Air dry. Please use your hands to pat, shake the dog bed and wait for 1-2 days to wait it back to fluffy status before using.
🐶Anti-Slip Bottom: This calming dog bed is equipped with non-slip bottom to keep the pet bed in position and keep your pets safe.

summary.text: Customers find the dog bed to be of good quality, soft, and comfortable, with their pets loving it, particularly senior dogs. The size receives mixed feedback - while it's perfect for medium-sized dogs, it's not suitable for larger breeds. Moreover, durability and value for money are also mixed aspects, with some saying it holds up well after washing while others report it falling apart during washing, and some consider it a great value while others find it overpriced. Additionally, the thickness receives criticism, with customers noting it's thinner than expected.

authors_reviews.title: This dog bed is amazing! It’s super soft, comfortable,
authors_reviews.text: This dog bed is amazing! It’s super soft, comfortable, and the perfect size for my dog. As soon as I put it down, my dog jumped right in and didn’t want to get out. You can really tell it provides great support, especially for resting and sleeping.The material feels high quality, and I love the raised edges—it gives my dog a cozy, secure feeling. It also looks nice in my home and is easy to clean.For the price, this is an excellent value. My dog sleeps better and seems much more relaxed. Highly recommend for any pet owner! 🐶🛏️✨
authors_reviews.author: Liusmary feria guerra
